verdict.rationale: Alacritty's own binary has documented CLI subcommands, including `alacritty msg` for IPC and `alacritty msg create-window` to script new windows, and it ships shell completions and a manual page. The evidenced surface is narrow, though, and nothing shows it is designed for agent or AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: documented coverage of the full CLI command and flag set, scriptable control beyond window creation, any agent-oriented features, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
